Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list and for flagging the procurement timeline. Recap and next steps below so we have alignment.

Recap / immediate answers:
- SOC 2: We have a current SOC 2 Type II report for our production inference platform (period ending 2026-06). I'll share a summary PDF and a secure link to the full report under NDA. See attached: redwood_soc2_report_summary.pdf.
- GDPR / DPA: Redwood offers the standard model where customers are the controller and Redwood acts as the processor for customer-provided data. There are limited cases where a different mapping is appropriate (e.g., data enrichment partnerships) — happy to discuss specifics for HealthPay's flows.
- SCCs: For EU customers processing regulated/health-adjacent data, we typically propose the modern modular SCCs (EU Commission 2021 modules). Module selection depends on the nature of the relationship — with HealthPay as controller and Redwood as processor, Module 2 (processor-to-controller) is not relevant; the standard controller-to-processor clauses are what we apply. If you have cross-border subprocessors/output flows to note, we can advise on the precise clause selection.

Proposed next steps (timeline):
1) I'll share the SOC 2 summary and a secure link by EOD today (completed — link below).
2) Aditya (cc'd) on our Legal team will start a DPA draft reflecting HealthPay as controller / Redwood processor; we aim to circulate a first pass by Tue 10/6.
3) Please send the vendor security questionnaire — we'll have someone on our Security team complete it; target turnaround 3–5 business days depending on depth.
4) If there are specific SCC module preferences from your legal team, loop them in and we'll align on language quickly.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_report_summary.pdf (summary), link to full report (requires NDA).

Happy to hop on a 20-min call with your counsel if that speeds closure.
